evidence: Swap test fails: a seed library, a car club or a council bulky-waste booking could take the find grid (white bordered cards, a square pale-green thumbnail, underlined bold name, meta line, green 'Available from' chip), the green filled button, the label/value summary boxes and the 'There is a problem' summary unchanged; only copy is product-bound (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png, confirm/default/1280-light.png).

Category-guess fails: a volunteer-run community service predicts a pale ground, one civic green, a humanist sans, bordered cards and a public-service form pattern; every identity-carrying element matches that default. Nothing is the predictable opposite either; it simply is the default.
Similar-prompt fails: 'reservation pages for a community bike-repair co-op' would land on the same grid, same chip, same calendar of day buttons with an 'Open' tag, same check-and-confirm page.
The thumbnail is the same wrench glyph on all ten tools, so the one image slot carries no product identity (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png, every card).

What does belong to the product is content and voice: 'returned when it comes back clean and working', 'Enough for a day of fixing shelves and a fence', 'We text you if a tool is returned late by the previous borrower', session times on the calendar. That is product content on a portable frame (rubric anchor 1).

unfinished: Placeholder thumbnails on show: an identical wrench icon in a pale-green square on all ten tool cards, at every width and theme (items-ladder-3m/default/*).
No focal point or signature on any screen; the first viewport of Find is a heading, a paragraph, an empty search field and the start of a uniform grid.
Headings differ from body only in size and weight, all in one sans; 'Tools', 'Details', 'Loan length', 'Pick-up day' read as a default document outline.

Empty bands at wide widths: basket and done pages end with a white footer band and then flat grey filling the rest of the viewport (basket/default/1280-light.png y>806, done/default/1280-light.png y>700).
Basket session choices laid out as one full-width card followed by a row of five cramped cards whose text wraps to three lines (basket/default/1280-light.png).
Tool names truncated with ellipses at 375 px so both cordless drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...' (items-ladder-3m/default/375-light.png).
Dark theme: the 'Available from' chips lose their tinted fill, leaving green text floating with an unexplained left indent (items-ladder-3m/default/1440-dark.png).
Details table on the tool page uses two different value columns (x=224 for Category/Deposit/Available, x=180 for Chuck/Batteries/Weight/Case) (tool/default/1280-light.png).
evidence: Clean, orderly and legible throughout: consistent 4 px radius, borders not shadows, one green action per page, comfortable spacing.
Nothing on any main screen rewards a look: no imagery of the actual tools or the room, no typographic moment, colour limited to button fill and chip text.
Reads as a competently themed public-service form: a member would find it trustworthy but not warm or memorable, and 'neighbourly' is carried only by the copy.
